name: item
title: Item
description: The generic list row: media, title, description, meta and trailing actions; becomes a link or button when interactive.
whenToUse: Any list of things: projects, files, services, people.
notFor: Tabular data with columns → table or data-grid.

states: selected (accent tint, 2px accent-ink bar on the inline-start side, text in ink; stays on hover)
focus (ring on the row's link or button)
keyboard: Main area is one link/button; actions are separate tab stops.
spec.motion: Hover tint arrives at once and leaves over --pui-motion-out; nothing else moves.

scopeDefaults.precedence: Instance prop, then nearest UIRoot.defaults entry, then existing component fallback. Only presentation keys are accepted; values, callbacks and operational state remain caller-owned.

spec.appearance: className/style address the existing visual root; native ref preserves internal measurements and focus. Typed classNames addresses documented existing parts; source owns deeper anatomy.

review.notes: Row is a link or button only when it does something; trailing actions stay separately focusable.

states: selected (accent tint, 2px accent-ink bar on the inline-start side, text in ink; stays on hover)
focus (ring on the row's link or button)
